objective: Candidate selectively separates finishing media from washers; PR 1436 twists an ice tray to release cubes and tips all cubes into a dish.
physical_skill: Both use bimanual grasping and controlled tilting of a loaded tray-like object. PR 1436 additionally tests opposing torsion to free attached cubes, while the candidate tests repeated orientation-dependent passage through apertures and retention of larger parts.
success_condition: PR 1436 rewards cracking cubes loose, placing all eight in the dish, restoring the tray, and returning the arms. The candidate measures media recovery, washer retention, spill and damage avoidance, screen support, release clearance, and dwell.
reason: The common tray handling is not the core ability: torsional release and complete dumping differ from selective sieving with retained workpieces.
